title: Beneficial
subtitle: 有益，究竟是哪一種「有好處」？

falseSynonyms.zh: 有效不等於有益 effective 表示能達到預期效果；效果本身未必對所有人有益。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The medicine is effective at reducing pain. A healthy diet is beneficial to long-term health.

falseSynonyms.zh: 必要不等於有益 necessary 表示必須有；必要的事不一定本身帶來正面好處。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The procedure is necessary. The exercise is beneficial.

falseSynonyms.zh: 令人愉快不等於有益 pleasant 表示感覺舒服；有益的事情未必令人愉快。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The treatment was unpleasant but beneficial.

falseSynonyms.zh: 無害不等於有益 harmless 只表示沒有傷害，不代表會帶來正面效果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The substance may be harmless without being beneficial.

falseSynonyms.zh: 成功不等於有益 successful 表示達成目標；某項成功行動未必對所有人有益。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The campaign was successful, but its effects were not beneficial to everyone.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞與名詞不同 beneficial 是形容詞；beneficiary 是受益者。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The policy is beneficial. Local families are the beneficiaries.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞／動詞與形容詞不同 benefit 可作名詞或動詞；beneficial 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The change brought a benefit. The change was beneficial.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有用不等於可使用 useful 表示能帶來幫助；usable 只表示可以使用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The data are usable, but not necessarily useful.
